messages:
Isha: Quick checkwe're still getting sporadic 99.99p tail on small requests when medium coalesces form. Looks like deterministic demotion rules are too brittle.
Marco: Yep. Deterministic thresholds cause synchronization where many requests get demoted at once => big gaps.
Noah: Proposed alternative: probabilistic demotion with per-tenant leaky-bucket credits. Instead of moving a request once it crosses X tokens, roll a biased coin with p = f(credit, seq_len). That smooths transitions.
Isha: Interesting. How do we ensure KV locality for sequences that should stay coalesced?
Noah: Two levers: 1) affinity boost: pinned requests get a sticky boost to reduce demotion prob, 2) epoch handshake: batches carry epoch_id so a demoted request can still attach to compatible KV shard if epoch matches.
Marco: Attaching across epochs sounds tricky. What's the handshake cost?
Noah: Minimal: epoch is a 64-bit counter and a few pointer checks. If epoch mismatch, we fall back to a cold-path which may rebind slices. We'll document metrics for epoch_mismatch_rate.
Isha: Config sketch:
```yaml
coalesce:
  mode: probabilistic
  base_demote_p: 0.05
  credit_window_ms: 500
  affinity_boost_pct: 0.6
  max_demote_p: 0.6
  tenant_credit_capacity: 2000
  epoch_ttl_ms: 2000
```
Marco: Also add a decay on tenant credits so a bursty tenant can't permanently hoard affinity. Leaky-bucket refill + decay.
Noah: Observability: emit `demote.attempt` events with fields: tenant, seq_len, credit_before, rand_sample, outcome. Add aggregate metrics: `demote_rate`, `epoch_mismatch_rate`, `cold_rebind_latency_ms`.
Isha: Safety: feature-flag `admission.coalesce_mode=deterministic|probabilistic` and a panic `coalesce.fallback_to_deterministic=true`. Also `coalesce.probabilistic.sample_pct` for shadow experiments.
Marco: One more: ensure per-core admission fast-path remains O(1). The probabilistic coin should be a few instructions using precomputed tables, not expensive RNG. Use xorshift64 and map to threshold compare.
Noah: Agreed. Implementation plan:
- @Noah: prototype coin-based demotion + epoch handshake (P0) 2d
- @Marco: add credit bucket service + decay logic (P0) 3d
- @Isha: wire traces & alerts for `epoch_mismatch_rate > 0.1%` and `demote_rate delta` 4d
- build-bot: schedule shadow canary: job=prob-demote-shadow-9, sample=2%, start=2025-05-05T14:00Z
build-bot: Shadow canary queued: id=prob-demote-shadow-9, sample=2%
Isha: For KV fragmentation, if cold_rebind_latency_ms climbs, enable `coalesce.force_pin_on_rebind=true` which will pin a few pages briefly. Use sparingly.
Marco: Good. We'll run deterministic replay and a short live shadow. If tail improves without KV regressions, move to canary.
Noah: Keep ML out for v1. Probabilistic approach is simpler and easier to reason about. We can explore a tiny learned p(t, len) later under a flag.
Isha: OK team, I'll update the RFC and push a slim PR. Ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
